content.short: Stablecoin-powered global money app with virtual account details, cards and business surfaces.
content.description: KAST is a stablecoin-powered global money app that lets consumers and businesses hold digital dollars and spend them anywhere via Visa cards. Users can deposit USDC and USDT across networks including Solana, Ethereum, Polygon, Tron, and Arbitrum, then get virtual account details, earn on balances, and pay online and in person with KAST crypto cards that convert stablecoins to fiat automatically. With deep integration into the Solana ecosystem and business-focused surfaces alongside its consumer app, KAST positions itself as a stablecoin neobank for people who live and transact globally. Backed by an $80 million raise, it aims to make dollar-denominated stablecoins a practical everyday account and spending method across borders and emerging markets.
